item.title: Build Scalable English Tutor Marketplace
item.description:
250-750 CAD | Project Title
Build a Professional International Online English Learning Platform – Scalable, Interactive Website & Teacher Marketplace
Project Overview
We are looking for an experienced web development team or senior full-stack developer to design and develop a high-quality international online English learning platform connecting students worldwide with qualified English teachers.
The platform will operate as an international marketplace where students can discover teachers, compare profiles, book lessons, make secure online payments, attend online classes, and track their learning progress.
We want a modern, professional, highly interactive website with excellent user experience, responsive design, and a scalable technical foundation.
Important: This is not a basic informational website or a standard WordPress template project. We need a functional online learning marketplace with separate student and teacher dashboards, booking systems, payment integration, and administrative controls.
1. Technical Requirements & Development Approach
We already have an active Hostinger hosting plan and prefer to use our existing infrastructure if technically suitable.
The developer must recommend the best technology and architecture based on:
- High performance and website speed. - Security and protection of user information. - Scalability for international expansion. - Easy future maintenance and development. - Ability to add new services and features without rebuilding the platform. - Clean, documented, and well-organized code. - Avoiding unnecessary expensive plugins and monthly subscriptions.
We are open to WordPress with a suitable LMS and marketplace architecture, or a custom development solution if it provides significantly better long-term value.
The developer must explain the recommended technology, hosting compatibility, limitations, and ongoing costs before development begins.
2. Main Website Features
Public Website
- Professional homepage and modern branding. - About Us and Contact pages. - Browse and search English teachers. - Teacher profile pages with photos, introduction videos, qualifications and experience. - Course and learning program pages. - Pricing and subscription pages. - FAQ and educational resources. - SEO-friendly website structure.
Student Dashboard
- Student registration and login. - Personal profile and account management. - Search and select teachers. - View teacher availability. - Book, reschedule and cancel lessons. - Online payment and booking history. - Upcoming lessons and notifications. - Access to online classrooms. - Learning progress and lesson history. - Teacher reviews and ratings.
Teacher Dashboard
- Teacher registration and application. - Profile creation and management. - Upload qualifications and supporting documents. - Identity and credential verification workflow. - Approval by administrator before becoming publicly available. - Set availability and working hours. - International time-zone management. - Manage bookings and students. - View completed lessons and earnings. - Track payments and payout history.
Online Booking & Scheduling
- International time-zone compatibility. - Automatic conversion of lesson times to the student's local time. - Teacher availability calendar. - Real-time or near-real-time booking management. - Automated booking confirmations and reminders. - Cancellation and rescheduling policies. - Prevention of double bookings.
Online Classroom
- Integrated video lessons. - Student and teacher communication. - Secure classroom access. - Screen sharing and interactive learning tools where supported. - Integration with a reliable third-party video provider if necessary.
Payment System
- Secure international payment processing. - Student payments for individual lessons. - Future subscription and package options. - Automatic commission calculation. - Teacher earnings dashboard. - Teacher payout management. - Refund and cancellation workflows. - Payment records and transaction history.
The payment architecture should support a marketplace model where the platform earns a commission from each completed lesson.
Administrator Dashboard
- Manage students and teachers. - Review and approve teacher applications. - Verify qualifications and documents. - Manage courses and learning programs. - Manage bookings and disputes. - Monitor payments, commissions and payouts. - Manage website content and pricing. - View platform statistics and reports. - Manage reviews, complaints and user accounts.
3. International Expansion & Future Features
The website must be designed to allow future development, including:
- Multiple languages, initially English and Arabic. - Additional countries and international markets. - Multiple currencies. - Monthly and annual student subscriptions. - IELTS and TOEFL preparation. - Business English programs. - Corporate and university partnerships. - Group lessons and classroom sessions. - AI-assisted learning features. - Mobile application integration in the future. - Referral and affiliate programs. - Advanced reporting and analytics.
These features do not all need to be developed in the first phase. However, the architecture must allow them to be added without major redevelopment.
4. Design & User Experience
We expect:
- Premium, modern and trustworthy design. - Simple navigation. - Excellent mobile, tablet and desktop compatibility. - Fast loading times. - Professional teacher profile layouts. - Interactive dashboards. - Clear booking and payment journeys. - Accessible and user-friendly interfaces.
We will provide design references and branding direction during development.
5. SEO, Security & Performance
The developer must implement:
- SEO-friendly URLs and website structure. - Technical SEO foundations. - Schema markup where appropriate. - XML sitemap and robots.txt. - SSL and secure authentication. - Role-based access permissions. - Secure document uploads. - Data protection and privacy controls. - Website backups. - Performance optimization. - Basic security hardening. - Error monitoring and logging.
6. Development Quality & Future Maintenance
This is a critical requirement.
We need a platform that another professional developer or development company can take over easily in the future.
The developer must provide:
- Clean and maintainable code. - Properly structured database. - Technical documentation. - Installation and deployment documentation. - API documentation where applicable. - Complete source code ownership and access. - All administrator credentials. - Plugin and third-party service inventory. - Clear instructions for future modifications. - No proprietary developer lock-in. - No unnecessary dependency on expensive proprietary tools.
All website files, source code, database, design assets and configurations must be handed over upon completion.
7. Hosting & Infrastructure
Our existing Hostinger plan should be evaluated before development.
We prefer to use it if it can reliably support the selected architecture.
If the proposed platform requires VPS, cloud hosting, external video infrastructure or other services, the developer must explain why and provide estimated monthly costs.
We do not want unexpected infrastructure expenses.
8. Project Delivery & Milestones
We prefer milestone-based development:
1. Technical consultation and architecture recommendation. 2. Website design and user interface approval. 3. Core website and database development. 4. Student and teacher registration and dashboards. 5. Booking, scheduling and time-zone integration. 6. Video classroom and payment integration. 7. Administrator dashboard. 8. Security, SEO and performance testing. 9. Final testing, deployment and documentation. 10. Complete handover and developer training.
Each milestone must be demonstrated and approved before payment.
9. Developer Qualifications
We are looking for developers with proven experience in:
- Online learning platforms (LMS). - Multi-vendor marketplaces. - Booking and scheduling systems. - International payment integrations. - API integrations. - WordPress or custom full-stack development. - Scalable database architecture. - Security and performance optimization.
Previous experience building tutoring platforms, teacher marketplaces or similar booking systems is highly preferred.
10. What to Include in Your Proposal
Please provide:
1. Your recommended technology stack and why. 2. Whether our Hostinger plan is suitable. 3. Examples of similar platforms you have developed. 4. Your proposed development architecture. 5. Estimated development timeline. 6. Total development cost, broken down by milestone. 7. Estimated monthly third-party and hosting costs. 8. Post-launch maintenance options. 9. Confirmation that full source code and ownership will be transferred.
Our Priority
We are looking for the best long-term technical solution, not simply the cheapest website.
We want professional finishing, reliable functionality, excellent user experience, manageable operating costs, and a scalable platform that can grow into an international online education business.
Please do not submit generic proposals or recommend a ready-made template without explaining how it will meet the complete project requirements.

item.title: Healing Soul Market

Beyond getting the catalogue online, I also need rock-solid payment, tax, and shipping rules configured so every order can be fulfilled without manual fixes.
Strong conversion rate optimisation is equally important. That means clean information architecture, persuasive product pages, upsell opportunities, abandoned-cart flows, and a checkout that loads in seconds on both mobile and desktop. Page speed targets are sub-3 s with a Google PageSpeed score of 85 +.
To make expectations crystal-clear, here’s what I consider a complete hand-off:
• Custom Shopify theme that mirrors my brand guidelines, is responsive, and passes WCAG AA colour/contrast checks • Bulk upload (CSV or API) of the initial product set with variants, high-res images, meta data, and collection tags in place • Fully configured checkout, payment gateways, automated tax, and zone-based shipping rates • Core on-page SEO: schema markup, meta titles/descriptions, clean URLs, and compressed media • Speed optimisation: lazy loading, code minification, and image/webP implementation • Google Analytics 4 and Facebook/Meta Pixel installed and firing correctly for each funnel step • Written SOP or short Loom walkthrough showing my team how to add new products and manage orders
I’m ready to provide brand assets, product data, and copy as soon as we kick off, and I’m happy to work in milestones—design approval, theme build, catalogue import, then final QA—so you’re never waiting on feedback. If you have recent large-SKU Shopify builds in your portfolio, I’d love to see them.
Please begin your proposal with the words "Shopify Expert" and include links to at least three Shopify stores you have personally built or optimized.

item.title: Donations SaaS MVP Build
item.description:
5000-10000 GBP | I’m ready to commission the first production-ready release of Taleevo, a multi-tenant donations and engagement platform for UK churches and charities. The goal is to take the project from architecture to deployment on AWS, handing me a fully documented codebase and live environment that my team will own outright.
Scope of the MVP • Donation flow: day-one support for NFC tap donations only (QR journeys can remain stubbed for future sprints). • Payments: Stripe Connect integration covering one-off, weekly and monthly recurring gifts, plus donor-selectable funds and full reconciliation logic. • Gift Aid: capture declarations and surface them in finance reports—no need to generate HMRC files or handle direct submission at this stage. • Multi-tenancy: each church or charity sits in its own tenant, with role-based access limited to administrators and finance staff. • Core admin: dashboards, user management, fund setup, basic reporting. • Security & DevOps: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, GDPR-compliant data handling and a documented AWS deployment playbook.
What I need from you 1. Evidence of similar payment or SaaS products you’ve shipped. 2. Your proposed tech stack (I’m open, though TypeScript/Node, React, PostgreSQL and AWS serverless are attractive). 3. A high-level delivery plan with milestones, timeline and fixed-price quote. 4. Post-launch support terms.
Acceptance criteria • All features above implemented, passing agreed test cases. • Source code, IaC scripts and AWS accounts transferred to my organisation. • Clean README and developer hand-over documentation. • Successful end-to-end test: donor taps NFC tag, completes Stripe payment, Gift Aid declaration is stored, finance report reflects transaction in the correct tenant.
If this fits your expertise, let’s discuss your approach and firm up scope quickly so we can move into build.

item.title: Magazine Production & Digital Operations VA
item.description:
5-10 GBP/hr | # Magazine Production & Digital Operations VA | WordPress, Facebook & AI
**Remote | 10–15 hours per week initially | Potential 40 hours per week from January 2027**
### About the Opportunity
We're launching **Around Ashford**, a brand-new UK local publishing and digital media business, on **1st December 2026**.
Our business includes six bi-monthly local magazines, an online business directory, community events, local advertising and plans for national franchise expansion.
Our website is almost ready, and we're looking for an exceptional VA to join us before launch, learn our systems and help us grow.
**This is a long-term opportunity, not a collection of occasional freelance tasks.**
### Your Responsibilities
**Magazine Production** - Produce professional magazine layouts ready for commercial printing. - Prepare print-ready PDFs, including CMYK, bleed, crop marks and correct resolution. - Manage advertising artwork, production deadlines and printer communication. - Coordinate production across six magazine editions.
**Facebook Marketing** - Create compelling, scroll-stopping Facebook posts. - Design graphics using Canva and AI. - Schedule regular posts to build awareness before and after launch. - Promote businesses, events and advertising opportunities. - Help grow our audience and generate enquiries.
**Email Marketing** - Write engaging, persuasive emails. - Schedule campaigns using Brevo. - Manage contact tagging, segmentation and email lists. - Create automated follow-up sequences and newsletters. - Track enquiries and responses.
**WordPress & Business Operations** - Learn and manage our new WordPress backend. - Maintain directory listings, events, jobs and advertiser accounts. - Manage customer enquiries, bookings and renewals. - Coordinate day-to-day administration and suppliers. - Find opportunities to improve efficiency using AI and automation.
### Communication Is Extremely Important
You MUST speak excellent, fluent English and be confident speaking with UK customers and suppliers by telephone or Zoom.
You must also have:
- Professional-quality headset and microphone. - Excellent audio quality without background noise. - Fast, reliable and secure internet. - Backup internet and power arrangements. - Secure computer and quiet working environment. - Availability during agreed UK working hours.
### The Person We're Looking For
Our founder is a fast-moving entrepreneur who values speed, initiative and results.
**We want facts, not lengthy explanations.**
When asked a question, give a clear, concise answer. We don't need a chapter explaining how you intend to complete a task.
You should be:
- Highly proactive and self-motivated. - Extremely organised and dependable. - Quick to learn new systems. - Confident making sensible decisions independently. - Comfortable using ChatGPT and AI daily. - Commercially aware and interested in business growth. - Able to work quickly without sacrificing quality.
**Previous experience producing magazines for commercial printers is essential.**
### Hours & Growth
**November 2026:** 10–15 hours weekly, learning our systems and preparing for launch.
**1st December 2026:** Official launch.
**January 2027 onwards:** Potential to increase towards 40 hours weekly as the business gains momentum.
Facebook marketing will be central to generating awareness and attracting customers.
The faster we grow our audience, acquire advertisers and generate revenue, the sooner we expect to increase working hours.
We want someone who is motivated to help make that happen!
### How to Apply
Please include:
1. Examples of magazines you have personally produced for commercial printing. 2. A 60–90 second video introducing yourself in English. 3. Your experience with WordPress, Facebook, Canva, Brevo and ChatGPT. 4. Details of your headset, internet connection and backup arrangements. 5. Your hourly rate and availability for UK working hours.
**Applications without evidence of magazine production experience will not be considered.**
We're looking for one outstanding person who wants to grow with our business and become a trusted, long-term member of our team.

TO APPLY Please provide concise answers: 1. Describe two Magento 2 stores or projects you have personally maintained, your responsibilities and one difficult problem you solved. item.title: Secure Multi-Tenant AI Video Editing, Distribution, and Project Manager Platform
item.description:
250-750 USD | Title: Senior engineer (Claude Code + security) to turn our AI video-editing factory into a secure, multi-client product
About us We’re a media distribution brand that makes a lot of short vertical video ads for TikTok and Instagram. Over the last few months we built an in-house AI “creative factory” with Claude Code. It does the work of a video editor: it picks up tasks from our project board and edits the raw creator footage into a finished ad. A human reviews and approves, and only then is the final file rendered and delivered.
It works, but it’s a prototype: it runs on one Mac, the keys sit in a .env file, and it’s built for one company. We want an engineer to make it professional, secure and repeatable so it can run for several businesses, each with its own brand, accounts and data.
What exists today
Pipeline: Node 22 server with SQLite. Stations are Intake → Edit → QA → Human review → Render → Delivery. A live “factory floor” web UI shows the jobs moving between stations. Workers: Python plus ffmpeg. Transcription (ElevenLabs Scribe), an assembly cut (best take of each line, retakes and dead air removed), and an LLM-planned main edit (captions, overlays, product shots, zooms) through OpenRouter (Claude, plus Gemini as a QA judge). Editor: each ad is an editable timeline project in an open-source web video editor (a customised OpenFilm Studio). The reviewer can open each timeline, change it and approve it. Integrations: the Asana API (task pickup, custom fields), the Frame.io V4 API (delivery) and Google Drive (footage). Guardrails: Claude Code hooks, subagents and skills, plus spend caps per day and per job.
What we want built
A cloud deployment. Everything runs on a server: footage never touches a laptop, and nothing is rendered until a human approves. A desktop workstation app for Mac. It’s a thin client: several jobs open at once, each in its own timeline window, all streamed from the cloud. Multi-tenancy. Each business gets its own isolated workspace: data, footage, brand kit, API connections, spend limits and users. Repeatable onboarding. Adding a new business should be config, not code: connect Asana, Drive and Frame.io, upload brand assets, set the rules. Production quality: CI, tests, monitoring, logs, backups and documentation.
Must-haves
Strong, hands-on Claude Code experience: CLAUDE.md, subagents, skills, hooks, MCP servers, and ideally the Claude Agent SDK and headless runs. Please show real examples. Cybersecurity, applied. We will test you on: secrets management and least-privilege service accounts tenant isolation (one client can never see another client’s footage or keys) zero-trust access to internal tools (no exposed admin ports) webhook signature checks prompt-injection defence: our agents read task text, scripts and comments, which are untrusted input supply-chain hygiene (pinned dependencies) and audit logs Node.js and Python in production, Linux servers, ffmpeg or other media-pipeline experience. Clear written English and async communication.
Nice to have
Swift or desktop-app experience (Tauri or native macOS) Experience with video at scale (proxies, streaming, GPU or headless rendering) Hetzner, Modal, AWS, or Cloudflare (Access/Tunnel) SOC 2-style thinking: access reviews, data retention, incident response
How to apply (answers without these will be skipped)
Start your bid with the word “VSRL”. Describe a Claude Code hook, subagent or MCP server you’ve built, and what it did. In 3–5 sentences: how would you stop an AI agent from following instructions hidden in a client’s task description? How would you isolate tenants’ files and API keys on a shared server? Links to relevant work (GitHub, case studies).
Budget: $300 / Month (negotiable) · Longterm job - at least for the next 6 months. We’ll share the full architecture under an NDA after an interview. Contract under USA cybersecurity and copyright laws.
